name: Ladenburg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Ladenburg (a red gate with two towers and crossed keys on white).
history: Municipal flag of Ladenburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ladenburg arms — red gate and keys on white
